articles.title: Supreme Court Hears a Big Case About Climate Change
articles.summary: The Supreme Court heard Boulder, Colorado's case asking two energy companies to pay for climate disaster costs.

articles.title: Is It a Person or a Computer? Tips for Little Kids and AI

articles.title: Quebec Picks a Party That Wants to Leave Canada
